title: The Expression Amrilato
description:
One day you find yourself stepping into a brand new world with a starkly different sky and a language you've never encountered. While lost and confused, salvation comes from a cute young girl who offers a helping hand and a small smattering of familiar words. As feelings blossom, the struggle to communicate remains real. Yet learning to express yourself could hardly bring sweeter rewards.

You and the protagonist, Rin, will learn the new world's language together. As you both learn Juliamo (which in the real world is Esperanto, an existing constructed language) you'll be able to grow closer to Ruka, and by the time the romance reaches its conclusion, you'll be familiar with a a new, real-world language yourself!

 

 

• All localized versions of the game are included with purchase for enthusiastic linguists looking to learn more languages!

The text in this game has been officially supervised by the National Esperanto Association in Japan, ensuring its accuracy and viability as a real educational tool.

Quizzes to test your understanding will have to be passed to progress the story, and they become available from the main menu along with every lesson introduced for those seeking to review the material further.

• An option to skip the quizzes is available for those seeking a story-only experience.

Enjoy one of the rare few tales that tackles the struggles of overcoming a language barrier head-on, and shows how important communication, expression, and connection really are.
description_short: Plunge into a new world with a completely foreign language in this romantic, yuri isekai visual novel about the struggles of communication and forging connection. Experience life in a foreign land. Enjoy a sweet, heartwarming romance. Learn Esperanto.
